title: Lifelong Learning of Scheduling Rules with Surrogate-assisted Genetic Programming for Dynamic Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2610.41158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Genetic programming (GP) has been widely used to learn scheduling rules for dynamic flexible job shop scheduling (DFJSS). However, trained rules tend to only generalise to tasks of similar scales and distributions, and when task characteristics change, learned rules often suffer significant performance degradation. Moreover, fine-tuning pre-trained rules on new tasks often leads to catastrophic forgetting, where prior knowledge is lost. This motivates the need for GP methods that can adapt to new tasks while preserving past knowledge, leading to a lifelong learning paradigm. However, lifelong learning in GP for DFJSS remains largely under-explored. To address this gap, this paper proposes a surrogate-assisted GP method for lifelong learning to handle sequential heterogeneous DFJSS tasks with job or batch arrivals. translated_abstract: 遗传编程（GP）已被广泛用于为动态柔性作业车间调度（DFJSS）学习调度规则。然而，训练得到的规则往往只能泛化到规模和分布相似的任务，当任务特征发生变化时，学习到的规则通常会出现显著的性能下降。此外，在新任务上微调预训练规则常会导致灾难性遗忘，即先验知识丢失。这促使人们需要能够在适应新任务的同时保留已有知识的GP方法，从而引出终身学习范式。然而，GP在DFJSS中的终身学习仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一种代理辅助的GP方法用于终身学习，以处理具有工件或批次到达的顺序异构DFJSS任务。该框架包含三个关键组件：一种用于平衡可塑性与稳定性的自适应两阶段训练策略，一种基于t
tldr: 本文提出一种代理辅助遗传编程方法，通过终身学习范式解决动态柔性作业车间调度中规则泛化能力差与灾难性遗忘问题，使其能适应顺序异构任务同时保留已有知识。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a surrogate-assisted genetic programming method that enables lifelong learning of scheduling rules for dynamic flexible job shop scheduling, adapting to sequential heterogeneous tasks while preserving prior knowledge and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
